A 1 mm thick 2.5 cm diameter high-
purity (>99%) 28Si target was placed on one arm of this
target changer with a graphite calibration sample and
a blank (empty, for these measurements) sample for
background measurements. These targets were rotated
into and out of the incident neutron beam on 10 min
intervals in order to match beam variations and
background conditions between these target positions.
Approved by K.J.Kelly on February 20, 2026.
n-gamma: Partial inelastic cross section populating
the first excited state, gating on the kinematic band
of this channel in n-gamma coincidences.
Neutrons emitted 15 degrees to the
left of the incident proton beam direction were
magnetically filtered for charged particle
contamination, collimated to 1.65 cm diameter, and
delivered to the target station of flight path 4FP15L
at total flight path from the spallation target of
21.50(1) m. Neutrons and gamma rays from neutron-
induced reactions on the targets of interest were
measured with the correlated gamma neutron array for
scattering (CoGNAC).
